# JALR must flush instructions fetched behind it; target base register is computed the instruction immediately before the jalr (RAW hazard into a jump)
# NOP-spaced variant generated by scripts/space_tests.py: every instruction is
# followed by 4 NOPs, so original instruction i sits at address 20*i.
# mem[0x110] holds a link register; its jump moved to 0x28, so the value is 0x2c.
# prog.hex also has an absolute code address rewritten in place (see OVERRIDES in the script).
# addr             value
0000000000000100   fffffffffffffbad
0000000000000108   000000000000002a
0000000000000110   000000000000002c
